speaker: Doctor
text: The right-sided pleural effusion combined with a large ovarian mass and ascites is highly suggestive of Meigs syndrome, which is typically associated with a benign ovarian fibroma. Do you have any history of thyroid disorders or autoimmune diseases that might contribute to these symptoms?

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the classic triad of benign ovarian tumor, ascites, and pleural effusion, the diagnosis is Meigs syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meigs syndrome
